description: Reads the app's own tokens (tokens module): "config", one user's "balance", the "report" (totals, what each stall is owed, the surplus), the "spends" (transactions) and saved "cuts". Changes nothing; neblla_tokens changes settings and voids spends.

action.description: What to read. By action: balance {userId, kind?}; report {kind?, from?, until?}; spends {the transactions}

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, default) or "pre" (the private test copy).

from.description: report / spends: from this ISO date.

until.description: report / spends: up to this ISO date.

name: neblla_tokens_read
title: Read app tokens
